{{Quote|We'd better break out the power jack and some spare links. The lifter winch wouldn't hurt, either.|Tallov Kersk to Karn|<ref name="Kabus">{{WEGCite|story=Ruins of Kabus-Dabeh|book=Tales of the Jedi Companion}}</ref>}}
A '''lifter winch''' was a tool. [[Tallov Kersk]] and his brother-in-law [[Karn (settler)|Karn]] planned to use a lifter winch in conjunction with a [[power jack]] to repair a broken track on their [[harvester crawler]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Muzara]].
